description: This file is a shell script used as a test harness for Perl gettext interface (Git::I18N). It sets up the environment, sources necessary libraries, and runs a Perl test script, verifying its output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of specified commands.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the given output is empty, used here to verify no error output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
